scope: Local read-only code investigation plus bounded startup and synthetic-summary IO measurements; no financial simulations, production parameter rows, source/queue mutations, uploads or pushes.

measurement_environment.platform: local Mac; existing core-reference Python environment
limitations: Filesystem and import caches were not flushed.
Local timings do not measure Oscar CPU, shared-filesystem latency or current campaign throughput.
No active campaign or repair processes were modified.

setup_measurements.method: Two fresh Python subprocesses import overnight bank and Budget, read committed production plan, validate it, and compute ten parameter specs/curve tables; no pricing.
setup_measurements.comparison: Worker process setup is amortized over 50 rows; saved request-runtime estimate is about109seconds per row including timeout budgets.

synthetic_io_measurements.method: Synthetic arrays of production summary shapes only, with independent seeded random values and block-diagonal row covariance; 100 packing repeats and20synthetic rows, seven block attempts plus one completed-row insert each, using existing pack/journal helpers in a temporary /private/tmp directory removed afterward.
synthetic_io_measurements.limitation: Synthetic local summaries are not a measurement of the Oscar shared filesystem or actual payload compression distributions.

code.detail: One process per one of eight fixed50-row shards.
Allocation waits for all children; no replacement shard is dispatched when a child finishes.

findings.finding: Completed sibling workers idle until the slowest fixed shard finishes.

saved_model_evidence.method: 5000seeded iid group resamples from initial1000request durations; group=max of8workers each summing50rows; four failures represented by860second budget.
saved_model_evidence.classification: Historical modeled scheduling overhead; not observed final-campaign waste or a current ETA.

findings.proposal: Persistent eight-worker allocations consume claimable50-row shards from a shared queue; refill a worker immediately when its shard completes. Keep one writer and exclusive lease per shard, original row entropy, complete requested-row ledger, and journal checkpoints. Record claim ownership and interruption recovery. Near allocation deadline checkpoint incomplete work as resumable rather than fail unattempted rows.
findings.simpler_variant: Assign substantially more than eight shards to an allocation and refill an eight-process pool locally; this retains an end barrier but amortizes it.
findings.classification: Scheduling change can preserve numerical/RNG law and each row result if worker implementation, environment, input and chunking remain unchanged; new orchestration provenance and plan are still required.
findings.current_campaign_action: None; do not edit a source-bound active producer in place.

code.detail: Loop over full path allocations at every rung.
Entropy includes rung; each rung uses an independent stream.
Fresh streams are also documented in rough_surface.

findings.finding: Rejected lower-rung samples are not reused. For a doubling ladder, work before terminal rung approaches another terminal-rung sample budget.
findings.proposal: Explore incremental samples and sufficient statistics only as a separate validated generator.
findings.classification: Changes RNG, same-sample control fit, stopping behavior and realized labels; not interchangeable with preserved producer continuation.

findings.finding: Persistent payloads hold small price/control/covariance summaries rather than simulated paths. Bounded local measurements make imports and summary IO unlikely to dominate pricing; Oscar filesystem latency remains unmeasured.
findings.recommendation: Keep checkpoint durability unless a production filesystem profile implicates it.

code.detail: Each path chunk is shared across all contracts in the block.
One multivariate least-squares fit per block.
Opt-in raw-control diagnostics compute extra covariance matrices.

findings.finding: The63quotes already use seven independent expiry blocks with nine strikes each. Two controls per expiry are shared across strikes. Some raw-control diagnostic covariances are computed but not retained by the bank.
findings.proposal: Profile a narrower diagnostic capture API; retain all currently saved values and control coefficients.
findings.classification: Eliminating unused diagnostic calculations can preserve estimator outputs; reusing one long path across the seven blocks changes current grids, streams and cross-expiry Monte Carlo covariance.

findings.finding: Inferred c is independent cheap observation augmentation, with no c-driven repricing. Constructing the union grid and curve table is locally about2.6ms/row.
findings.classification: Caching immutable task geometry can preserve numerical values; it is a small optimization compared with pricing.

representative_benchmark_design.source_section: cases; committed synthetic panel, not production parameter rows
representative_benchmark_design.suggested_bounded_kernel_cases: 622steps and1796steps, then whole63quote surface at first32768paths; fixed shared seeds and matched outputs.
representative_benchmark_design.changing_discretization: Reducing steps, merging expiry grids, omitting normal channels or altering adaptation requires separate numerical/RNG qualification.
